ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; approximately 95% of the visible surface consists of low-intensity black/dark grey pixels with approximately 5% high-intensity white punctate pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark grey distribution across both lobes; sparse, stochastic white punctate pixels distributed across the surface area; localized high-intensity cluster at the lower central junction caused by water aeration/turbulence.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped depression with an approximate 45-degree interior angle and a depth of approximately 15% of the visible fluke vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the continuous boundary; approximately 12-14 distinct peaks per lobe with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5 and 20 units.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex curvature extending from the median notch to the distal fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of circular high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated specifically on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible barnacle colonization on the distal margins of both fluke tips.
